description.value: BC Liquor Store in Osoyoos is a provincial government-operated retail outlet selling wine, beer, spirits, coolers, and ciders, part of the 198-store BCLIQUOR chain. Located on Main Street, it is a standard chain retail stop where touring cyclists might purchase beverages for camp or accommodation. It accepts credit and debit cards and is noted as wheelchair accessible in OSM.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM identifies this as a BC Liquor Distribution Branch retail store (shop=alcohol, branch=Osoyoos) at 8110 Main Street. The website confirms an active BCLIQUOR chain store but the locator page rendered only generic chain boilerplate — no store-specific amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are present for this location. No OSM tags address cycling amenities, so all cyclist-relevant criteria remain null.
concerns: Website locator page rendered only generic chain boilerplate — store-specific phone number and address were not confirmed via website content.
